children: Overview
Sweden supply chain trading firm's Q3 net sales rose 16.6% yr/yr, organic growth 6.5%
Q3 EPS improved to SEK 1.16 from SEK 0.75
During the quarter, company acquired UK-based D.C. Iron to support growth strategy
Outlook
Company expects gross margin to remain at a high level in coming quarters
Company notes slight improvement in market conditions but sees higher purchasing prices from Asia
Bufab aims to gain market share, improve margins and cost base, and deliver strong cash flow
Result Drivers
MARKET SHARE GAINS - Co said net sales growth was driven by market share gains and stronger demand in electronics, mechatronics, electrification, digital infrastructure, aerospace and defence
MIX AND PRICING - Co attributed margin improvement to better customer and product mix, value-based pricing and cost control
ACQUISITION CONTRIBUTION - Co said D.C. Iron acquisition performed well and integration is progressing as planned
